projects.title: ATSify (ResuMerge)
projects.description: An AI-powered resume converter that reformats resumes into clean, ATS-friendly documents so they parse correctly in applicant tracking systems before a human ever sees them.

caseStudy.role: Solo developer — product, design, and build
caseStudy.overview: Most resumes are formatted for human eyes: columns, icons, graphics, creative layouts. Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) that companies use to pre-screen candidates often can't parse that formatting correctly, which means a well-written resume can get silently rejected before anyone reads it. ATSify (built and shipped as ResuMerge) takes a person's existing resume and uses AI to restructure it into a clean, ATS-compatible format while preserving their actual content and experience.
problem: Visually appealing resumes frequently fail ATS parsing, dropping or scrambling key sections like work history and skills.
Manually reformatting a resume for ATS compatibility is tedious and easy to get wrong.
Most existing tools either charge upfront or lock the core conversion behind a paywall.
solution: Built a web app where a user uploads their existing resume and the app extracts and restructures the content using the Google Gemini API.
Output is a clean, single-column, ATS-friendly resume format that preserves the original wording and experience.
Deployed on Vercel for fast, reliable hosting with minimal ops overhead.
Kept the core tool free to use, with optional support via Ko-fi rather than a hard paywall.
caseStudy.results: Live and publicly available at resumerge.vercel.app for anyone to convert their resume free of charge.
